title: Lively Dense Ligurian Celery Lasagna
description: A briny and dense Italian dish featuring celery salt and ferment-kimchi, perfect for a festive meal. This plant-based friendly recipe is a twist on traditional lasagna.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped celery until tender.
In a large bowl, combine the tofu ricotta, nutritional yeast, and celery salt, and mix well.
Add the ferment-kimchi to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Spread a layer of marinara sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the tofu ricotta mixture over the noodles.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the sauce, and finally the remaining tofu ricotta mixture.
Top the lasagna with chopped fresh parsley and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
